caption: Each bar is one 2-week sprint at the pairing-reduced velocity of 8 points: three sprints reach 24 of the 31 backlog points, so the fourth sprint delivers the last 7 and the work ends at week 8.

spec.aria: A four-sprint timeline over eight weeks: each of the first three 2-week sprints delivers 8 story points, reaching 24 of 31, and the fourth sprint delivers the last 7 points.
